title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Long-Rental Bands of the ProBuild Discount
content:
Ridgeline Tool Rental discounts longer rentals in bands under the ProBuild Rewards rental discount.

## Band rule

Longer rentals are discounted in bands:

- on an agreement whose rental time includes a four-week period, rental time of at least 2000.00 dollars is discounted in full at the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement plus 3 points, and rental time below 2000.00 dollars in full at the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement;
- on an agreement whose rental time includes weekly periods but no four-week period, the first 1000.00 dollars of rental time is discounted at the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement and the rental time above 1000.00 dollars at that rate plus 3 points, the two bands being added together;
- on an agreement billed in daily periods only, the whole rental time is discounted at the ProBuild discount rate of the agreement.

The rental time in this rule is the rental time the ProBuild discount is worked out on: the rental time billed on the agreement, leaving out any rental time billed at the weekend special. Whether the rental time includes a four-week or a weekly period is read from the rate periods of the rental time lines on the agreement. No band amount is rounded on its own; the discount is rounded to the nearest cent only at the end.

## Band table

| Rental time lines on the agreement | Rental time | Discounted at |
|---|---|---|
| include a four-week period | 2000.00 or more | the rate plus 3 points, on the whole amount |
| include a four-week period | below 2000.00 | the rate, on the whole amount |
| weekly periods, no four-week period | first 1000.00 | the rate |
| weekly periods, no four-week period | above 1000.00 | the rate plus 3 points |
| daily periods only | whole amount | the rate |

## Worked figures (hypothetical rate of 10 percent)

| Rental time | Periods billed | Discount |
|---|---|---|
| 2400.00 | one four-week period | 13 percent of 2400.00, 312.00 |
| 1950.00 | one four-week period | 10 percent of 1950.00, 195.00 |
| 2000.00 | one four-week period | 13 percent of 2000.00, 260.00 (exactly 2000.00 takes the higher rate) |
| 1600.00 | two weeks and two days | 10 percent of 1000.00 is 100.00, plus 13 percent of 600.00 is 78.00: 178.00 |
| 800.00 | daily periods only | 10 percent of 800.00, 80.00 |
